name: altimate-code
description: Gives Claude Code altimate-code's model-free data tools (column-level lineage, impact analysis, PII detection, data-diff, FinOps, query equivalence, dialect translation, warehouse queries) through its MCP server, or through `altimate tool run` when MCP servers are not allowed, with delegation to the altimate-code agent for long dbt jobs, access to a linked Altimate workspace's knowledge, and the workspace's team rules in each session.

maxScanBytes.title: Largest BigQuery scan without asking (not used yet)
maxScanBytes.description: Not used yet: the BigQuery scan check isn't in this version, so no run is held. When it ships, a dbt run, build or show that BigQuery estimates would scan more bytes than this waits for your approval (0 never waits; other warehouses are never held).

healthBlocksPush.title: Project health blocks git push (not used yet)
healthBlocksPush.description: Not used yet: the project health check isn't in this version, so git push is never refused. When it ships, on refuses a push while the check finds new issues in the models you changed; off only shows them.

healthConfigPath.title: Project health check config
healthConfigPath.description: Not used yet: the project health check isn't in this version. Path to a DataPilot health check config file, relative to the dbt project. Empty uses the default checks.

commentsPollSeconds.title: Team comments refresh (seconds)
commentsPollSeconds.description: Not used yet: team comments aren't in this version. How often the team's comments on shared docs are fetched again.

commentsInContext.title: Team comments in Claude's context
commentsInContext.description: Not used yet: team comments aren't in this version. When on, the open comments on a model Claude reads or edits are added to its context. Off keeps them out of Claude's context.
